author: Lee Aylward
html: One con that comes to mind is that with a cron job you would end up generating a Recent Activity list for people who aren't going to be visiting the site any time soon. I rarely check my papal account, so it seems incredibly wasteful for them to generate any lists for me or people like me (of which I predict there are millions).
